title: Frankfurter Leben lines up offer for Athora’s German unit – report
title_zh: 《法兰克福生活》正在为阿索拉的德国部门提出报价——报告
summary: Apollo Global Management-backed Athora has been weighing the future of its German operation, including a possible disposal, after finding it difficult to expand the business.
summary_zh: 在发现业务扩展困难后，阿波罗全球管理公司支持的 Athora 一直在权衡其德国业务的未来，包括可能的出售。

title: Broadcom, Apple extend chip supply deal through 2031
title_zh: 博通与苹果将芯片供应协议延长至 2031 年
summary: Broadcom said on Monday it has agreed to expand its partnership with ‌Apple through 2031 to develop and supply ‌a range of custom chips, sending the shares of the chipmaker ​up nearly 4% in premarket trading.
summary_zh: 博通周一表示，已同意将与苹果的合作关系扩大到 2031 年，以开发和供应一系列定制芯片，这使得该芯片制造商的股价在盘前交易中上涨了近 4%。

title: ITV and Sky reshape British TV landscape with $2.1 billion deal
title_zh: ITV 和 Sky 以 21 亿美元的交易重塑英国电视格局
summary: Comcast's Sky has agreed to buy the broadcast channels and streaming service of Britain's ITV for £1.6 billion ($2.13 billion), creating a British champion to compete with global players YouTube, Netflix, Amazon and Disney.
summary_zh: 康卡斯特旗下的天空电视台已同意以 16 亿英镑（合 21.3 亿美元）的价格收购英国独立电视台 (ITV) 的广播频道和流媒体服务，打造英国冠军品牌，与全球巨头 YouTube、Netflix、亚马逊和迪士尼竞争。

title: Super Micro Computer (SMCI) Expands Its Edge AI Computing Hardware Offerings
title_zh: Super Micro Computer (SMCI) 扩展其边缘人工智能计算硬件产品
summary: Super Micro Computer Inc. (NASDAQ:SMCI) is one of BlackRock’s 30 most important AI stocks right now. BlackRock is the largest institutional owner in the company, with 7.21% or 43.36 million outstanding shares, according to Yahoo Finance data.
summary_zh: Super Micro Computer Inc.（纳斯达克股票代码：SMCI）是贝莱德目前最重要的 30 只人工智能股票之一。雅虎财经数据显示，贝莱德是该公司最大的机构所有者，拥有 7.21% 或 4336 万股流通股。

title: Foes of PNM takeover applaud as regulators order $400 million stock deal undone
title_zh: 监管机构下令撤销 4 亿美元股票交易，PNM 收购的反对者欢呼雀跃
summary: New Mexico regulators voted Thursday to nullify a year-old purchase of stock in the state’s largest electric utility by a private equity firm and issue penalties against both, finding they violated state law by completing the sale without approval.
summary_zh: 新墨西哥州监管机构周四投票决定取消一家私募股权公司一年前购买该州最大电力公司股票的行为，并对两家公司进行处罚，发现他们未经批准就完成出售，违反了州法律。
